Payroll Officer – Full-Time
Location: Welshpool, Western Australia 6106
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $75,000 – $90,000 per annum (depending on skills and experience)

MINPROVISE INTERNATIONAL PTY LTD is a leading total solutions provider delivering specialist maintenance and shutdown services, engineering, fabrication, project services, and sustaining capital works. We also provide a comprehensive range of equipment and products, supporting the mining, oil & gas, and construction industries across Australia and internationally.

We are currently seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Payroll Officer to join our growing team on a full-time basis.

About the Role
As a Payroll Officer, you will be responsible for managing payroll processing activities, maintaining accurate employee records, and ensuring employees are paid correctly and on time. You will work closely with the finance, human resources, project, and operational teams to ensure payroll processes comply with company policies, awards, employment conditions, and relevant legislation.

Key Responsibilities
•	Process end-to-end payroll activities for employees, including weekly and fortnightly payroll cycles.
•	Maintain accurate employee payroll records, including salaries, allowances, deductions, leave balances, and employment details.
•	Verify timesheets, overtime, allowances, leave applications, and payroll adjustments.
•	Ensure payroll calculations comply with relevant awards, enterprise agreements, employment contracts, and legislation.
•	Process new employee onboarding, payroll setup, and employee changes.
•	Manage employee queries relating to payroll, leave entitlements, deductions, and payments.
•	Prepare payroll reports, reconciliations, and supporting documentation for management and finance teams.
•	Process superannuation payments, payroll tax, PAYG withholding, and other statutory obligations.
•	Maintain accurate records and assist with payroll audits and compliance reviews.
•	Liaise with HR, project managers, supervisors, and employees regarding payroll-related matters.
•	Assist with improving payroll processes and maintaining payroll system accuracy.
•	Ensure confidentiality and security of employee payroll information.
•	Follow workplace health and safety policies, company procedures, and quality management systems.

Skills and Experience
•	Minimum 1–2 years of full-time experience as a Payroll Officer or in a similar payroll/finance administration role.
•	Experience processing payroll in a medium to large organisation is highly regarded.
•	Strong understanding of payroll processes, employment conditions, and statutory requirements.
•	Experience with payroll software and Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
•	Strong attention to detail and accuracy in handling financial and employee data.
•	Excellent organisational and time management skills.
•	Ability to manage confidential information professionally.
•	Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively with employees and management teams.

What We Offer
•	Full-time, permanent employment.
•	Competitive salary of $75,000 – $90,000 per annum.
•	Opportunities to work within a growing mining and industrial services organisation.
•	Ongoing training and professional development.
•	Supportive team environment with long-term career opportunities.

Legend Australia (CABAC) is a leading designer, manufacturer and distributor of electrical products, cable connectivity solutions and infrastructure products servicing the electrical wholesale, commercial and infrastructure sectors across Australia. The company is committed to delivering quality products, reliable service and innovative solutions to its customers.

As a Project Coordinator at Legend Australia, you will coordinate electrical product and infrastructure projects, ensuring documentation, schedules, procurement activities and stakeholder communications are managed efficiently. This position requires excellent organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to work collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders.

Responsibilities and Tasks:

•	Monitor contractor and supplier performance, identify variations against project scope and report findings to management.
•	Prepare project submissions, progress updates, meeting minutes and management reports to support informed decision-making.
•	Collect, analyse and interpret project data to monitor performance, identify risks and recommend process improvements.
•	Support procurement activities by coordinating materials, equipment and delivery schedules to meet project requirements.
•	Provide timely advice to management on project matters requiring attention and implement approved actions to facilitate successful project outcomes.

Qualifications and Skills:

•	Relevant qualification.
•	Minimum 1 year experience as a Project Coordinator.
•	Strong project coordination and organisational skills.
•	Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
•	Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
•	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management software.

Salary:
The role offers a remuneration package ranging from $79,000 – $95,000 p.a. plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

Discount Building Material Pty Ltd, located in Parramatta NSW 2150, is an Australian technology-driven building materials platform connecting leading manufacturers with a nationwide network of resellers. result.description:
An established General Practice Superclinic is seeking a dedicated  General Practitioner  to join its cohesive team and assist with an existing and rapidly growing patient base. This busy centre operates on a  mixed billing  model and offers GPs the benefit of intelligent practice analytics (such as Cubiko) to support individual choices regarding patient fees and practice management. 

 The clinic is an established, modern centre with excellent facilities, including eleven doctor consultation rooms, a dedicated treatment room, and a small procedure room. Located in a prime position on the Eastern Shore, the centre offers both designated all-day parking for practitioners and high foot traffic from its close proximity to the region's largest mall and a bus station. The team composition is highly supportive, including an experienced administrative team and three full-time nurses to provide crucial assistance with treatment room activities and Chronic Disease Management (CDM) care, allowing the GP to focus on patient care. The centre is co-located with an Integrated Care Centre providing allied services such as physiotherapy, mental health support, and oral health services, with pathology, pharmacy, and imaging services conveniently located nearby. 

 The centre is classified as a  DPA approved location , making it an excellent option for doctors on the FSP, PEP, and other 3GA programs seeking to fulfil Fellowship pathway requirements. The practice champions clinical autonomy and offers highly sought-after flexible working arrangements. It provides extensive support for professional growth, including a partnership that simplifies and records CPD requirements, free in-house educational opportunities, and discounted registration for industry events.
